These findings suggest that age-related reductions in CSF flow can arise through multiple pathways.

dd1ea96092bdd1f4.title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of LP-003 Injection in Patients With Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria Who Remain Symptomatic Despite Treatment With H1 Antihistamines
digest: This is a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, active-controlled Phase III clinical study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of LP-003 injection in patients with chronic spontaneous urticaria who remain symptomatic despite treatment with H1 antihistamines.

evidence.quote: Lead sponsor: Longbio Pharma.
Interventions: LP-003 Injection, Omalizumab.

283cee1d13316371.title: Differentiation of stem-like CD4+ T cells modulates early effector responses in colorectal cancer.
digest: Using imaging mass cytometry in patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), we observed T helper 1 (TH1)-like immune architectures in mismatch repair-deficient tumors associated with response to anti-programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) immunotherapy.
Clonal analyses revealed that stem-like CD4+ T cells differentiated into TH1-like cells after PD-1 blockade.

8ed34ba9f8956d58.title: The aging human brain exhibits reduced hemodynamic and cerebrospinal fluid flow waves during sleep
digest: This work shows that cerebrospinal fluid flow during sleep is impaired in the aging human brain, before the onset of any neurological disorder, and identifies parallel neural and cerebrovascular mechanisms contributing to this difference.

evidence.quote: The aging human brain exhibits reduced hemodynamic and cerebrospinal fluid flow waves during sleep.

494d0e2b5e216aae.title: Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Protective Effect of Larazotide Acetate in Individuals With Well-Controlled Celiac Disease
digest: Conditions: Celiac Disease, Celiac Disease in Adolescents.

The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if larazotide acetate, which will be tested at two doses and compared to placebo, can help prevent signs and symptoms of celiac disease in patients with well-controlled celiac disease who are following a gluten-free diet.
Both adults and children (ages 12 years and up) will be allowed to enroll in this study.

evidence.quote: Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Protective Effect of Larazotide Acetate in Individuals With Well-Controlled Celiac Disease.
Interventions: Larazotide Acetate, Placebo.

e6f6a222a2cd9b7c.title: Scaling productive aging to mitigate cumulative disadvantage
digest: Productive engagement among older adults — which spans employment, volunteering and family caregiving — functions as a multidimensional driver of healthspan, economic stability and social cohesion across individual and societal levels.
Here we advocate for a paradigmatic shift from observational research towards intersectional, experimental interventions designed to mitigate cumulative, life-course disadvantages.
